description: A curated iOS development toolkit with focused skills for Swift, SwiftUI, persistence, diagnostics, simulator testing, App Store delivery, and optional Expo, Chat, and Nuke integrations.

defaultPrompt: Inspect this iOS project, identify its stack and constraints, and help me implement the next feature with appropriate tests.
Diagnose this Swift or SwiftUI issue using project evidence and verify the smallest reliable fix.
Prepare this iOS app for release and report build, signing, metadata, and submission readiness.
interface.longDescription: Develop native SwiftUI and UIKit apps with project-aware guidance for architecture, concurrency, UI, persistence, networking, security, testing, observability, simulator debugging, signing, and App Store delivery. Includes optional Expo/EAS, ExyteChat, and Nuke workflows, read-only discovery tools, source provenance, and validation fixtures. Apple builds and simulator operations require a suitable Apple environment; account operations use your existing authorized tools.
interface.shortDescription: Build, test, and ship iOS apps

name: ios-development-studio
